interaction_scope: Owner-completed interactive login followed by read-only dashboard inspection
observed: An owner-authenticated Envia dashboard route was reached.
The dashboard did not display a provider-designated Sandbox indicator during the read-only inspection.
The dashboard presented an account-verification step as incomplete; no verification action was taken.
No shipment, label, pickup, payment action, webhook configuration, or API request was created by the evidence capture.
not_established: Whether the authenticated context is a provider-designated Sandbox environment.
Availability of an Envia Sandbox API credential.
Availability or configuration of an Envia webhook signing secret.
Receipt, signature validation, or replay handling of a provider-originated webhook by PayLock or Yaqeen.
redactions: No account email, account identifier, token, password, session cookie, request header, or provider-private dashboard data is retained.
